subject: Media Center Groundbreaking Ceremony
overview: City officials, school administrators, students, and media guests gathered for a ceremonial groundbreaking and site tour of the new joint high school media technology program and community access television studio.

items.title: Introductory Remarks and Introductions
items.summary: Superintendent Roy Belson welcomed attendees and introduced city officials, school committee members, and media guests gathered to celebrate the combined vocational media program and community access studio.

items.title: Mayor's Address
items.summary: Mayor Stephanie Muccini Burke highlighted the benefits of restoring public access television to Medford at the high school and announced a $756,000 construction contract awarded to Integrated Construction Corp.

items.title: Vocational School and Student Remarks
items.summary: Vocational Technical High School Director Dr. Heidi Riccio introduced media technology students Abby Brady and Gabby Smith, who shared their experiences in the expanded vocational program.

items.title: Guest Media Industry Speakers
items.summary: Broadcast media professionals Lisa Hughes, Courtney Cox, and Hank Morse addressed the audience with advice and encouragement for students entering the media field.

items.title: Site Tour and Groundbreaking
items.summary: Dr. Heidi Riccio led attendees through the active construction site, detailing the floor plan for the new TV studio, playback room, and office concept.
